draw_list.ordering: the list is consumed sequentially; its producer/sort remains a separate contract

object_transform.tile_base: object+$02 is added to each geometry tile before hardware OAM write
object_transform.attributes: object+$03, inherited palette bits from object+$05 or $7E:007C, and object+$04 are combined before per-part XOR/flip handling

dynamic_geometry.pose_pointer: object+$00 points to a count-prefixed runtime geometry record
dynamic_geometry.tile_normalization: geometry_tile is pre-base; tile is the final OAM byte after object+$02

visibility.x: native builder rejects parts outside its signed horizontal bounds before OAM emission
visibility.y: native builder rejects parts outside its signed vertical bounds before OAM emission
visibility.note: exact branch thresholds are preserved in CODE_80:9663/CODE_80:96FE; callers must not replace this with arbitrary browser clipping when validating native output

limitations: This extract proves composition mechanics, not the semantic identity of every object in the draw list.
Static packed geometry and runtime dynamic geometry use distinct branches and must not be conflated.
